field.label: Enable ctrld
field.help: Starts ctrld as the client-facing DNS listener on the interfaces configured below. Unbound and Dnsmasq keep running unchanged.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Verbosity of ctrld's own service log. info is a reasonable default; use debug when diagnosing routing/policy problems.

field.label: Local-zone resolver host
field.help: Address of the local resolver that *.in-addr.arpa reverse zones and the internal domain are delegated to -- normally Unbound, rebound to listen on this loopback address only.

field.label: Local-zone resolver port
field.help: Port Unbound is listening on after being rebound to loopback-only. Checked against Unbound's live configuration when available.
